scope: Canonical evidence plus explicitly referenced source candidates; no deployed-backend completeness claim

evidence.candidateReferenceAnchors: Unmodified imported source and documentation use path:line anchors. Mutable TypeScript legacy evidence uses path#legacyRoutes/SYMBOL anchors, verified against the preserved symbol, method, operation and path. Semantic effect and exact request binding remain unverified.
evidence.extensionPolicy: Validate nonempty unique IDs, typed methods/effects and evidence fields; never use an exact count as the schema
evidence.readSafety: safe_to_probe is historical metadata, not live permission. No live adapter or callable entry is activated

readerRequirements: Explicit authorized scoped authentication channel; no credentials in output or provenance
Verified instructor ownership, selector contract, exact student/course/record/curriculum/occurrence binding
Timestamp, adapter revision, page/cursor coverage, expected and observed counts, no duplicate keys
Partial and unknown remain explicit; empty output does not prove no records
outputMetrics: UTF-8 JSON bytes for identical query and different projections. Compact omits detail fields; summary omits all endpoint rows. These are projection savings, not lossless compression, token counts or live speed claims.

runtimeBoundary.expandedCatalog: TypeScript/Bun-only metadata inventory; every entry noncallable
runtimeBoundary.legacyPython: Unmodified harness/routes.py and harness/cli.py retain exact-54 count checks. Existing 54 canonical records still work as before, but expanded-catalog dual-runtime parity is not claimed.
runtimeBoundary.futureDiscovery: Structured HTML, forms, links, documented source and sanitized DevTools metadata only; no screenshot-driven discovery, credential extraction or session export

pending: Native app API and identity joins
